notes: [Variant for fleet eb543899 (digtown-01 KEPT and promoted on 2ec19385): branch st2-on-eb54389 @ 5e663860 = eb543899 + st2-on-2ec1938's diff (4798b708 over 2ec19385), no conflict; digtown's eb543899 only records digs (both reviewers).] THE TOWN RECOUNT ORDER (operator 10-14, after chest clear #2: STATE f9331b98, docs/reports/census/clear2-20261014T0221Z/). The clear's fence left every town container UNKNOWN; a deposit the cobble cap or a stock target cannot judge is refused (`_stock_refused ... *_unknown`), and the only deterministic recount fired at 34+ slots, so hive-a and placebo-a stayed 0/24 and 0/17 recounted for 2 h while hive-a-Delta was refused 55 times -- a refusal with no remedy the bot performs from where it is (CLAUDE.md). Counts also expire after 6 h, so the refusal recurs on every town (12 h: hive-c 123 ... hive-d 4 rows). THE CHANGE: at town (inTown), holding a name a plan refuses as town_stock_unknown/town_cobble_unknown, with a reachable uncounted town container, the deterministic order count_town counts up to 3 containers now (the existing reconciliation), whatever the bag's size; 60 s cooldown (the look charged too), 10 min backoff after a fruitless count; a container the recount cannot reach (a real no-path, or a walk that resolved out of reach) or open is a RECOUNT MISS in the town's own <townKey>.recount.json -- never in the container memory the deposit/withdraw/full-chest recovery read (both reviews st2-r1: that would close the bank and let the recovery build chests) -- and two misses >= 10 min apart within 6 h keep it out of every bot's recount (the reachability check: placebo-a-Echo's 'No path' chest 251,74,-148); an interrupted walk ends the recount, our own clock, a slow open and an unloaded cell back off that bot only; an arrival check before the open; the pending-open interlock. One _stock_recount row per order; runner evidence count_effect. Admission is unchanged (the order runs before the model is asked). RESIDUALS (both reviews): a refusal from coverage=false (an unloaded column under the town square, or the 256-scan cap) has no key and no order (today's rule); after a clear a bot may run count_town back to back until its town is counted (~1 run per 3 containers, ahead of its milestone work); an aborted run backs off 10 min even if it counted some (its row keeps the partial count; its row omits fails=). REVIEWS: Codex r1 CHANGE -> r2/r3 APPROVE; Claude r1 CHANGE (P1) -> r2 CHANGE (tests/mutants) -> r3 APPROVE. TESTS: npm test 250/250 (this variant; 249/249 on 2ec19385); mutants-stocktarget 82/82 killed on a fresh archive (reproduced by the Claude reviewer); towndeposit RECOUNT CHAIN through the real loop/admission/skills (a fenced town, a 7-slot bag, the model proposing deposit: count_town first, then the deposit admitted and judged on the count) + its CONTROL (recount held off: refused at admission, nothing counts -- the dead end reproduced); stocktarget.test pure order / keys / count_town incl. no-path -> a recount miss with the container memory untouched, interrupted / timeout / unloaded -> no miss, out of reach -> a miss, pending open, abort -> one aborted row. REVIEWS and PAPER: docs/reports/stocktarget-02-reviews-2026-10-14.txt, docs/reports/stocktarget-02-paper-2026-10-14.txt.
